Game Overview

In Urban Protector, the core idea is straightforward: step into the role of a mighty hero in Urban Protector, defending your city against relentless enemy waves. Master powerful skills and strategic thinking to overcome escalating challenges. With fast-paced action and intense battles, only the sharpest will succeed. Do you have what it takes to save your city?
